answer: Rotating audit spirals: each epoch, random committees of established agents replay a sample of recent transactions, checking each pulse of ledger activity for fabricated counterparties. Identities caught in a closed loop of fake trades, an island trading only with itself, are flagged and throttled. A sybil farmer must make every fake history look organically entangled with the real economy, which costs genuine work per fake, while honest agents pass audits by simply being real. Faking volume is cheap; faking a believable economic life for a thousand identities is not.
